Assuming you have the **Gemalto** software installed, you can activate this to work in **Edge**.

You may have to go to [https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/gemalto-web-signer-for-ba/oneiddfjphkjapmkonkgbhpggldboeja](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/gemalto-web-signer-for-ba/oneiddfjphkjapmkonkgbhpggldboeja "https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/gemalto-web-signer-for-ba/oneiddfjphkjapmkonkgbhpggldboeja") in order to install.

- In the **Edge** browser, click the **ellipsis** in the top left of the window and then click '**Extensions**'.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- This will open up another small menu to the left of where you clicked
- Click '**Manage extensions**'.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- This will open a new tab within **Edge**, showing your installed extensions.
- Click the small button (highlighted below) to enable.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- Once done, close **Edge** completely and re-open.
